summary: Using the emulated states, the test asserts the await function slept enough times, proving it waits through unusual states integration tests can't reliably trigger.
questions: How do I test a wait loop without really waiting?
How can I check my module keeps polling until the resource is ready?

answer_card.title: Test wait logic with fake states
answer_card.answer_md:
```python
rds_i.await_resource(rds_client_double, "some-instance", "available", mod_mock,
                     await_pending=1)
assert len(sleeper_double.mock_calls) > 5, "await_pending didn't wait enough"
```
This checks the wait keeps going through odd states that happen in reality but can't be forced in integration tests.
